downloader.intro: Download videos, playlists and channels from YouTube to your computer.

steps.text: Copy the link of a YouTube video, playlist or channel.
Paste the link in the URL field. Ctrl+L moves the cursor to the field.
Click Add. The app reads the link and puts each video in the queue.
Click Start. The app downloads the videos one at a time.
When a row shows Done, click Open file.

shots.name: downloader
shots.alt: The Downloader page. Numbers 2 to 5 mark the URL field, Add, Start and Open file.

transcript.intro: Get the transcripts of all the videos on a YouTube channel.

steps.text: Paste the link of a YouTube channel in the Channel URL field.
Click Add. The app reads the list of videos on the channel.
Click Start. The app gets the transcript of each video.
When the channel shows Done, click Open ZIP. The ZIP file contains the transcripts.

shots.name: transcript
shots.alt: The Transcript page. Numbers 1 to 4 mark the Channel URL field, Add, Start and Open ZIP.

tts.intro: Change text into speech with a voice model that runs on your computer.

steps.text: Select a voice model in the Model list.
Click Get to download the model. Then click Load.
Type text in the Text box, or click Paste or Load file.
Select a voice and a speed.
Click Generate. When the job ends, click Open file.

shots.name: tts
shots.alt: The Text to speech page. Numbers 1 to 5 mark the Model list, Get, the Text box, the voice and Generate.

converter.intro: Make video files smaller, cut them or get the audio from them.

steps.text: Select the Compress task. The Cut and Extract tasks have other settings.
Drop files on the panel, or click Browse.
Select a preset for Compress. Balanced is the default.
Click Add. Then click Start.
When a row shows Done, click Open file.

shots.name: convert
shots.alt: The Convert page. Numbers 1 to 5 mark the Compress task, the drop panel, the preset, Add and Open file.

capture.intro: Take a picture of part of your screen and put marks on it.

steps.text: Push F2 or click Capture region. Then drag a box on the screen.
Click the new shot in the strip below the image.
Select a tool, for example Arrow or Box. Then drag on the image.
Click Save to keep your marks, or click Copy image.

shots.name: capture
shots.alt: The Capture page. Numbers 1 to 4 mark Capture region, a shot, the Arrow tool and Save.

settings.intro: Set the folders and the tools that the app uses.

steps.text: Read the note next to the name of the Download card. It tells you when the card saves your changes.
In the Download card, click Browse. Then select the folder for your downloads.
Look at the Readiness card. Click Fix next to each item that is not ready.
In the MCP card, select your AI client. Then click Copy prompt.

shots.name: settings-download
shots.alt: The Settings page. Numbers 1 and 2 mark the save note and the Browse button of the Download card.

shots.name: settings-setup
